method: Isolated native bosses at waves 5/10/15/20, all difficulties. Pressure: fixed health phase 0/1/2, no player attacks, 45 seconds, stationary or continuous orbit (160/320px target radius; 230px/s, fast=299px/s), three seeds with different starting bearings. No warning-aware dodging, dash, armor, dodge, shields, healing, weapons, adds, normal enemies or overtime. Environmental slow and native contact/hazard collision remain active. Player max_health=100 preserves real hit i-frames; only current health is an oversized reservoir to accumulate damage without death. Status clocks advance explicitly. TTK: stationary player, unlimited attack reach, 10 hits/s at listed raw DPS, native armor, directional guard, damage budget and health phase pauses; 90s censoring (defeated=false is NOT a kill time). TTK and pressure are separate controlled experiments, not real run builds, win rates or a human difficulty ranking. Schema 2: release counts use damaging mechanic births (Prince bomb impacts, not both launch and impact); Court releases use native verdict/portal/pulse counters. Prince projectile counts include launched bombs separately from hearts. Attack warnings exclude Court guard turns. State occupancy and stationary time are sampled at 60Hz. Optional flee_wall steers away from the boss while reserving 0.6s room to turn at walls, never reads hazards or warnings.
